title: Dad's Place Still Says My Last WORDS 🔊
description:
In our town, the last thing you say in a house stays there, out loud, until somebody says something new. Everybody says I love you at the door, just in case.

Two years ago I said something to my dad in his place that I can't take back, and I haven't been back since. Every night since, a pickup parks outside my building with its lights off, and somebody sits in it for an hour.

It's made up. A blocky story, built with code and Blender.
pin: Comment SUNDAY if you'd have gone back sooner.
